hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'gh pr create' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE -- '(--base|-B)([[:space:]]+|=)main([[:space:]]|$)' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE -- '(--head|-H)([[:space:]]+|=)dev([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "PRs into main must come from dev.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "PRs into main must come from dev: use gh pr create --base main --head dev. Feature and fix PRs target dev."}}'; fi
